_about: Which song plays where. The songs are Deovandski's 2014 BIDU songs (legacy/2014-bidu-concept/BIDU songs/), made into loops by tools/make_bidu_music.py, which also writes loop_start: where each song goes back to after its end, in seconds (the intro plays once). Stages pick their song with "music" in worlds.json; anything without one uses its world's.
